entrance.eyebrow_zh: SHA.W.Z / 云野自由 / AI 系统构建者 / 活体仪器室
entrance.eyebrow_en: SHA.W.Z / YUNYE ZIYOU / AI SYSTEMS BUILDER / LIVING INSTRUMENT ROOM
entrance.title_zh: 给说不清的东西，留一台会回应的仪器。
entrance.title_en: A responsive instrument for what cannot yet be said.
entrance.body_zh: 这里不是项目陈列柜，也不是一张技能清单。它是一间仍在工作的仪器室：图像、手势、时间与记忆被放进可被重访的小系统，等人靠近，才开始发生。
entrance.body_en: This is neither a project cabinet nor a skills list. It is a working instrument room: images, gestures, time, and memory are held inside revisitable systems that begin only when someone comes close.
core_positioning_zh: 我做能接住一种具体创作判断的仪器。
有的接住说不清的情绪，有的接住创作，有的接住证据。
core_positioning_en: I do not build one-size-fits-all Agents.
I build instruments that can hold a specific creative judgment.
Some hold the unspoken emotions; some hold creative work; some hold evidence.

zh.label: 它接住什么
zh.text: 接住“我怕它会消失”的悬空感：一朵花被允许一直开着，而不是被催着在一刻说清自己。

zh.label: 用户必须做什么
zh.text: 用户必须先亲手调节花的颜色、形态或节律；不是被动领取一份已经替她完成的安慰。

zh.label: 系统如何判断
zh.text: 系统只读取明确的参数与触碰，不猜测情绪，也不替人给这朵花命名。

zh.label: 世界怎样回应
zh.text: 参数与触碰改变花的状态，声音随之出现；回应可见，却不催促解释。

zh.label: 为什么只能这样交互
zh.text: 只有先做出一个微小选择，钟罩里的“持续开着”才是来访者亲手留下的照料，而不是自动化的背景动画。

en.label: What it holds
en.text: It holds the suspension of “I am afraid it will disappear”: a bloom is allowed to continue rather than being rushed into a single explanation.

en.label: What the visitor must do
en.text: The visitor must tune the flower's colour, form, or rhythm first, rather than receiving comfort already completed for them.

en.label: How the system decides
en.text: The system reads only explicit parameters and touch. It does not infer an emotion or name the flower for a person.

en.label: How the world responds
en.text: Parameters and touch alter the bloom while sound arrives with it. The response is visible without demanding an account.

en.label: Why this interaction must be this way
en.text: Only a small, deliberate choice makes the bell jar's continuing bloom care left by the visitor, rather than automated background animation.

zh.label: 它接住什么
zh.text: 接住“来不及看完这么多”的巨大与短暂：每颗恒星的一生只有三十秒，仍可以被安放进一只瓶。

zh.label: 用户必须做什么
zh.text: 用户必须决定何时靠近并打开瓶口；主页不在背后替任何人运行宇宙。

zh.label: 系统如何判断
zh.text: 系统只把“进入”这一次明确选择当作开始条件，并以有限时长组织恒星的显影、变化与熄灭。

zh.label: 世界怎样回应
zh.text: 点击进入后，瓶内星体在自己的三十秒里运行；玻璃边界让巨大的尺度仍像能被捧住。

zh.label: 为什么只能这样交互
zh.text: 宇宙必须由人亲自打开，短暂才不是被算法抢走的注意力，而是一段被选择的停留。

en.label: What it holds
en.text: It holds the immensity and brevity of “there is too much to see”: every star lives for thirty seconds, yet can rest in a bottle.

en.label: What the visitor must do
en.text: The visitor must choose when to approach and open the bottle. The homepage does not run a cosmos in the background for anyone.

en.label: How the system decides
en.text: The system treats that explicit entry as its only start condition, then gives stars a finite interval to appear, change, and go dark.

en.label: How the world responds
en.text: After entry, the stars run within their thirty seconds. The glass boundary makes an immense scale feel holdable.

en.label: Why this interaction must be this way
en.text: A cosmos must be opened by a person so brevity is not attention taken by an algorithm, but time deliberately chosen.

zh.label: 它接住什么
zh.text: 接住那些既不想被固定、也不想被视作消失的时刻：散开并不等于失去，聚拢也不等于必须留下。

zh.label: 用户必须做什么
zh.text: 用户必须把视线或指针停在山势上；不需要提交一段自我说明，只需要愿意停留。

zh.label: 系统如何判断
zh.text: 系统通过光标射线与粒子景观的相对位置判断局部扰动，不从来访者身上推断任何心理状态。

zh.label: 世界怎样回应
zh.text: 青绿层峦在局部关系中松动、显现、重新聚合；回应不是弹窗，而是一处山势被重新看见。

zh.label: 为什么只能这样交互
zh.text: 只有让靠近改变观看关系，作品才保留“聚散随缘”的余地；把它做成点击领奖会取消这种余地。

en.label: What it holds
en.text: It holds moments that neither want to be fixed nor called lost: scattering is not loss, and gathering is not an obligation to stay.

en.label: What the visitor must do
en.text: The visitor must rest a gaze or pointer on the ridges. No personal account is required, only a willingness to stay.

en.label: How the system decides
en.text: The system uses the relation between raycasting and the particle landscape to decide local disturbance; it infers no psychological state from a visitor.

en.label: How the world responds
en.text: Blue-green ridges loosen, appear, and gather anew in local relation. The reply is a mountain seen differently, not a popup.

en.label: Why this interaction must be this way
en.text: Only an approach that changes the act of seeing preserves room for things to gather and scatter; turning it into a reward click would remove that room.

responsive_worlds.reason_zh: 一只童年屏保里的鱼缸，因为记忆被保存，才值得被再次打开。
responsive_worlds.reason_en: A childhood screensaver aquarium is worth reopening because it keeps a memory of the visit.
responsive_worlds.action_zh: 主要动作：投食、轻叩玻璃、停下来观察。
responsive_worlds.action_en: Primary gesture: feed, tap the glass softly, and stay to watch.
responsive_worlds.response_zh: 回应方式：鱼群、声音与保存下来的来访痕迹一起改变。
responsive_worlds.response_en: Response: the fish, sound, and retained traces of a visit change together.

responsive_worlds.reason_zh: 它把一次掠过树冠的手势留成沿枝传播的风，因此每次重访都能重新开始一阵辽阔。
responsive_worlds.reason_en: A gesture over its canopy becomes wind travelling through branches, so every return can begin another small expanse.
responsive_worlds.action_en: Primary gesture: brush across the canopy.
responsive_worlds.response_zh: 回应方式：风、叶与五声音阶沿距离逐段传开。
responsive_worlds.response_en: Response: wind, leaves, and pentatonic sound travel outward by distance.

responsive_worlds.reason_zh: 它是一只可被照料的瓶：种子并不需要被催熟，回来看一眼就是一次允许。
responsive_worlds.reason_en: It is a bottle that can be cared for: seeds do not need to be rushed, and looking in again is itself permission.
responsive_worlds.action_zh: 主要动作：触碰或按住一颗琥珀晶种。
responsive_worlds.action_en: Primary gesture: touch or hold an amber seed.
responsive_worlds.response_zh: 回应方式：晶种短暂发芽，萤光触角与涟漪在玻璃内出现。
responsive_worlds.response_en: Response: a seed briefly sprouts; luminous tendrils and ripples appear inside the glass.

responsive_worlds.reason_zh: 夜晚被缩小到一只钟罩里；它不要求完成什么，只等下一次轻轻敲门。
responsive_worlds.reason_en: Night is reduced to a bell jar. It asks for no completion, only waits for the next gentle knock.
responsive_worlds.action_en: Primary gesture: touch the bell jar.
responsive_worlds.response_zh: 回应方式：月苔苏醒，微光与潮汐式波纹向外扩散。
responsive_worlds.response_en: Response: moon moss wakes, sending glow and tide-like waves outward.

responsive_worlds.reason_zh: 风车在听，风铃在回答；它像一处可以步入的天气，而不是一次性的展示。
responsive_worlds.reason_en: The windmill listens and wind chimes answer; it is weather one can enter, not a one-time display.
responsive_worlds.action_zh: 主要动作：走进山谷，靠近风与风铃。
responsive_worlds.action_en: Primary gesture: enter the valley and move toward wind and chimes.
responsive_worlds.response_zh: 回应方式：风车、风铃与环境声彼此接力。
responsive_worlds.response_en: Response: windmill, chimes, and ambient sound hand the reply from one to another.

responsive_worlds.reason_zh: 情绪不必马上被命名；选一种天气，给自己六十秒重新吸气，是可以反复使用的日记入口。
responsive_worlds.reason_en: An emotion need not be named at once. Choosing weather and taking sixty seconds to breathe is a diary entrance designed for return.
responsive_worlds.action_zh: 主要动作：选择天气，开始或结束 60 秒呼吸。
responsive_worlds.action_en: Primary gesture: choose weather, then begin or end a 60-second breath.
responsive_worlds.response_zh: 回应方式：玻璃小屋的气象、像素粒子与环境音随心境切换。
responsive_worlds.response_en: Response: weather, pixel particles, and ambient sound shift inside the glass room.

workbenches.role_zh: 把难以命名的感受做成必须由人完成、并会给出回应状态的体验。
workbenches.role_en: Turns hard-to-name feelings into experiences that require a human action and return a response state.
workbenches.flow_zh: 感受 → 隐喻 → 不可替代动作 → 回应状态
workbenches.flow_en: Feeling → metaphor → irreplaceable action → response state

workbenches.members_zh: content-creation-router / inner-voice / echo-caption / duotone-screenprint / social-video-editor / h5-publish
workbenches.members_en: content-creation-router / inner-voice / echo-caption / duotone-screenprint / social-video-editor / h5-publish
workbenches.role_zh: 把创作输入交给场景判断与专业执行器，并把最终确认保留给用户。
workbenches.role_en: Routes creative input through scene judgment and specialist executors while keeping final confirmation with the user.
workbenches.flow_zh: 输入 → 场景判断 → handoff → 专业执行器 → 用户确认
workbenches.flow_en: Input → scene judgment → handoff → specialist executor → user confirmation

workbenches.role_zh: 把增长与创作判断拆回事实、推断和待验证项，再以可复盘的实验继续。
workbenches.role_en: Separates growth and creative judgment back into facts, inferences, and open validations before continuing with reviewable experiments.
workbenches.flow_zh: 事实 → 推断 → 待验证 → 单变量实验 → 真实复盘
workbenches.flow_en: Facts → inference → to be verified → single-variable experiment → real retrospective

rejections.en: I do not treat missing data as `0`.

rejections.zh: 不把发布完成写成增长成立。
rejections.en: I do not write a completed publication as proof that growth happened.

rejections.zh: 不替用户确认创作意图。
rejections.en: I do not confirm a user’s creative intent on their behalf.

rejections.zh: 不让公式替代真实读者目标。
rejections.en: I do not let a formula replace a real reader goal.

rejections.zh: 不让点击成为没有隐喻意义的特效。
rejections.en: I do not let a click become an effect with no metaphorical meaning.

rejections.zh: 不用万能 Agent 掩盖专业判断的缺失。
rejections.en: I do not use a one-size-fits-all Agent to conceal the absence of professional judgment.

path.body_zh: 开发 → 自动化测试 → 数据产品 → 把创作判断工程化的 AI 系统构建者
path.body_en: Development → QA automation → data products → an AI systems builder who engineers creative judgment
